summary: This document details the implementation of a web user control named StudentPreInfControl in the HSPnet system, focusing on managing student prerequisites and infection control information.
purpose: The purpose of this user control is to facilitate the management and display of student infection control prerequisites, utilizing various UI elements such as forms and dropdowns for data selection and modification.

workflows.name: Update Student Prerequisite Details
steps: User triggers an update action on the form.
New values are extracted from dropdowns and text inputs.
If validation passes, updates are submitted to the database.
Upon successful update, user is redirected to the Infection Control page.

business_rules: If the page is not valid, cancel the update operation.
Use dropdown selections to update specific prerequisite fields.
validations: Page validity is checked before updating data.
JavaScript is used to manage dropdown selections and default values.
conditions: If the user session is null, cancel data selection operations.
Determine button visibility based on the screen's editability.
system_behavior: Redirects user to the Infection Control page upon update completion.
Disables edit fields and calendar controls if the screen is not editable.
dependencies: Depends on the HSPnetSession for user session management.
Utilizes the HSPnet Framework for UI and data operations.
